limitations: Separate resources only, known VOD duration, 100ns timebase, contiguous confirmed prefix, immutable track/container identity
fMP4 and WebM codec/header restrictions from SDK 1.14-1.19 remain; WebM requires DefaultDuration video and known-size clusters without lacing
New mixed end-to-end fixtures use stereo Opus/AAC; existing fMP4 mono Opus regression retained
Qt verifies active audio codec/rate and changing decoded frames; Classic verifies graph/status and decoder reads without optical/physical output measurement
No physical A/V synchronization, 30-minute drift, HDR/10-bit final Qt surface or 4K realtime qualification
VP8/Vorbis, arbitrary MKV/Ogg, muxed/remux, segments/live, multiple audio/subtitles/chapters/metadata and real Harvester integration remain outstanding
Installed Windows EXE/profiles unchanged; hardware and Wayland excluded; YouTubeHarvester unchanged
